notes.text: The sheet has no visible authorial page number. A pale 65 at the extreme lower left belongs to another unnamed hand and is recorded as foliation. The body consists of paragraphs d) and e), two stacked coproduct displays and a final prose paragraph with interlinear revisions.

In d), the manuscript writes the opening hooked map as Sigma_j to Sigma_ji, then introduces the index expression I_<i,x by a displayed-in-line definition. It describes bordant subspaces and their transversality, with a reference to b). The literal source and target of the opening hook are retained from their visible indices. H's editorial expectation of a different map is not part of the manuscript text.

In e), the manuscript describes the displayed s_ij map as transversal to the stated system of bordant morphisms. The b-label subscript locally favours ik and remains marked against ki; the first source subscript is overdrawn. No mathematical interpretation was used to replace those written indices.

The lower paragraph gives coproduct notation for Sigma and the locally angular Sigma(1), then connects conditions a), b), c) with an injective pair map and the graph of a strict order relation. The manuscript subsequently calls the b map an immersion propre and describes the phi expressions using the words strictement croissante, injective and totally ordered in written short forms. These are reports of the manuscript's assertions; this transcription supplies no proof check or new theorem.

The cancellation at the top preserves a readable Sigma and a distinct stop to its right. The stop is outside the cancelling stroke. The replacement par l'ens is written above the cancelled tels-que/Sigma phrase; indices is a separate insertion above the preceding crossed range. Only one closing parenthesis is visible after b in the next line.

Four local raised signs—in the lower coproduct display, the s,b expression, the pair-map source and the lower b-map source—show left-angle contours joined to opening parentheses. The lower phi source has a different, crowded star-like cluster whose reading remains open. A separate tall looped glyph between that Sigma and its arrow is included with both its letter and live/struck state uncertain. The target's bold upright and diagonal Z-like path are retained as an uncertain Sigma/I overwrite.

The s,b connector following the two displays and the final induced-phi connector are plain shafts in the image. The other inspected maps retain their visible heads, including the solid terminal head in the lower b expression. Underlines below the s and b labels are separate written strokes.

The short form before transversaux has two l ascenders and a small raised ending, retained as uncertain mutuell with raised t. The final abbreviation has two tall uprights, a low return and a separate stop; tot. and tt. remain open. C's extra raised t was considered against the crop and was not separately visible. Injective and enfin occupy the final ordinary baseline; enfin is readable despite H's illegible marker. All expansions are confined to the abbreviations list.

coverage.macro_only_differences_ignored: Equivalent underline wrappers, inserted/deleted wrappers, text/math spacing, braces, to versus longrightarrow where an actual head is present, and en-dash/em-dash TeX spellings for the single written dash. H's editorial notes and page synopsis are excluded from manuscript text. The packet's apparent extra I in the coproduct subscript is a token-alignment artefact: both literal files contain i,j in I. Certainty-only changes are recorded as doubts or mark decisions; the cancelled-Sigma resolution has an explicitly uncounted row.
coverage.visual_pass_detail: Original whole image and both premade halves were each explicitly viewed once in the first-pass workflow. All 27 saved crops were explicitly emitted and read. The p13–p19 image batch whose output was truncated was not credited; those crops were subsequently emitted in smaller batches. Existing p04, p05 and p11 were reused to verify audit quotation extent; no second crop was made.
coverage.audit_coverage: The preliminary 27 boxes include every insertion, every cancellation or uncertain overwrite state, the full formulas containing C or proposed doubts, all four written argument-1 numerals and the foliation65, the lexical differences, and every medium/low-confidence departure. Foreground readings quote the complete target phrase/formula inside each box; adjacent clipped line fragments are contextual.

comparison_counts.counting_rule: Compare the leading proposed reading with each witness, ignoring equivalent macros and certainty-only changes; retain undecided status for unresolved new readings.
